failures.summary: Near-duplicate leakage across field splits remains, and label-conflicting same-photo pairs are not all removed. The fix only links dHash distance <=6 (DHASH_DISTANCE in src/sprout/data/field.py), and group_near_duplicates uses a different pHash threshold. A search at dHash<=8 or pHash<=8 over datasets/manifests/field.csv still finds about 10-17 genuine same-photo pairs that sit in different field splits (train/test, dev/test, train/dev), including one with Potato early blight versus Potato late blight on the alamy potato leaf. Reproduce: run orchestration/evidence/tmp-T1.2/xsplit.py (counts) and view orchestration/evidence/tmp-T1.2/d8.png and ph8.png. The plan says 'Deduplicate against each other' and 'split by group', and the prior failure was exactly cross-split near-duplicates, so this is not resolved for the test split that is meant to be used once. No test measures cross-split similarity on the real manifest at more than the thresholds the code already uses, so the tests cannot catch it.

Some single-link false merges in field_conflicts.csv. Groups g053829 (3 unrelated images), g052046 (corn rust, unrelated corn leaf, apple photo, corn rust duplicate) and g051965 (corn blight pair plus an unrelated tomato leaf) join unrelated images because DHASH_DISTANCE=6 is applied to min over 8 flips/rotations of 64x64 dHash with single-link union-find. About 8-10 valid photos (about 4% of 223 removed) are removed, including images whose only 'conflict' is the false link. Not a large share on its own, but the same single-link design is the cause of the weakness above.

notes: Everything else in the earlier failure is fixed and verified: plain pytest passes without raw images, the three previously untested branches now each break a test when removed, and the class_map reasons are right. The over-correction is modest: 26 of 30 viewed conflict groups are true same-image/scene, 92 of 98 groups are tight clusters (pairs <=6 bits, typically 0-1), 6 have chains and 3 of those are false merges. The failure is for leakage that remains, not for over-removal. A fix could add a pHash link or a looser threshold restricted to a stricter check (for example both dHash<=8 and pHash<=10), complete-linkage or a size cap on merged groups to avoid the false chains, and a test that runs the real manifest through an independent similarity check across splits. Not checked: GPU, network, and datasets/raw were not touched; test results above depend on raw images being present for my own scripts, which read them via the manifest paths. Mutation runs were done on a clone in orchestration/evidence/tmp-T1.2/clone, not the main tree.
